pages.text: Everyone spawns in the same village: the $(bold)capital$(). It has a bell, villagers with trades, and beds. It will grow as the server does — it is the first market, the first station, and the first thing raiders come for.$(br2)Set your spawn with a bed early. There is no fast travel in this world; distance is real.

$(bold)Day one checklist:$()$(br)- Wood, a crafting table, a bed in the capital$(br)- Check the season (calendar, or the sky's colour)$(br)- Food: villager farms are fair game to replant$(br)- A campfire before nightfall if it is cold$(br2)Mobs are harder than you remember. A wolf helps; a dog helps more (see Threats).
